IGUI_PhunTaxi_NotDiscovered: You have not found that place yet
IGUI_PhunTaxi_NoSuchPoint: That place is no longer on the map
IGUI_PhunTaxi_BuiltPointsOff: This server does not let players build pay phones
IGUI_PhunTaxi_BuiltPointLimit: You already have %1 pay phones standing
IGUI_PhunTaxi_TaxiOnTheHouse: Hop on in, this one is on the house
IGUI_PhunTaxi_AlreadyPlaced: You have already chosen where to wake up
IGUI_PhunTaxi_CannotGoThere: You cannot get there right now
IGUI_PhunTaxi_PhoneTooFar: You need to be standing at the phone
IGUI_PhunTaxi_GarageDoorShut: The door is jammed shut. The taxi is the way out
IGUI_PhunTaxi_Desc_Nothing: You do not know anywhere yet.
IGUI_PhunTaxi_Desc_Pending: Where to? This ride is on the house, and you only get the one. Keep an eye out for pay phones: every one you use is somewhere a taxi can take you next time.
IGUI_PhunTaxi_Desc_Known: Where to? Keep an eye out for pay phones: every one you use is somewhere a taxi can take you next time.
IGUI_PhunTaxi_Tip_AlreadyPlaced: You have already woken up. This is a map of the places you know.
IGUI_PhunTaxi_Confirm_Spawn: Take the taxi to %1? You only get to choose once.
IGUI_PhunTaxi_Desc_Editor: %1 points, %2 renamed, %3 saved, %4 deleted. Renames, added and deleted points, and kept phones are saved to PhunTaxi.json on the server, so they survive a wipe, and players see them the next time they open their list.
IGUI_PhunTaxi_NotAdmin: Only an admin can edit spawn points
IGUI_PhunTaxi_Tip_SetupMenu: Show Spawn point setup and Spawn points when you right click in the world. Off again next time you play.
IGUI_PhunTaxi_Tip_remove: Take this point out of PhunTaxi.json for good.
IGUI_PhunTaxi_Tip_delete: Hide this point from everybody, and keep it hidden after a reboot or a wipe. Nobody loses it from their list: Restore puts it back.
IGUI_PhunTaxi_Tip_restore: Put this point back. Everybody who had found it has it again.
IGUI_PhunTaxi_Tip_Keep: Keep this phone after a wipe. If it goes missing, it is put back the next time its square loads.
IGUI_PhunTaxi_Tip_Release: Stop keeping this phone. It stays where it is, but the next world will not have it.
IGUI_PhunTaxi_Prompt_AddPoint: Name for a spawn point at %1
IGUI_PhunTaxi_CannotDeletePhone: A pay phone is released or taken down, not deleted
IGUI_PhunTaxi_LastStart: That is the last start point. Make another point a start point first, or new characters will know nowhere.
IGUI_PhunTaxi_PointHere: There is already a spawn point on that square
IGUI_PhunTaxi_NotSavedPoint: Only a point an admin added can be changed that way
IGUI_PhunTaxi_BadKind: A spawn point cannot be found that way
IGUI_PhunTaxi_NoPhoneHere: There is no pay phone there
IGUI_PhunTaxi_NotKept: That phone is not being kept
IGUI_PhunTaxi_NotSaved: The server could not save that. Check its log.
IGUI_PhunTaxi_CannotPlacePhone: A phone could not be put there
IGUI_PhunTaxi_Tip_StandBeside: Stand where a character should wake up, then click the square beside you. The phone goes on that square, facing you.
IGUI_PhunTaxi_PhoneFound: It rings once as you pass. You will remember this phone: %1
IGUI_PhunTaxi_Desc_Taxi: Where to? The fare is on the Go button, paid from your change.
IGUI_PhunTaxi_Desc_TaxiNothing: You do not know any other pay phones yet.
IGUI_PhunTaxi_TaxiNowhere: No taxi will come: you do not know any other pay phones yet
IGUI_PhunTaxi_TaxiOff: There is no taxi service here
IGUI_PhunTaxi_TaxiPhoneUnknown: Pick up this phone before calling a taxi from it
IGUI_PhunTaxi_TaxiZombies: No taxi will stop with the dead this close
IGUI_PhunTaxi_TaxiSafehouse: Nobody can take you there: %1 is inside somebody else's safehouse
IGUI_PhunTaxi_TaxiCantAfford: You need %1 in change for that ride
IGUI_PhunTaxi_PhoneTooClose: Too close to another pay phone. They have to be %1 squares apart
IGUI_PhunTaxi_CannotBuildHere: A pay phone cannot go there
IGUI_PhunTaxi_NoKit: You need a pay phone kit
IGUI_PhunTaxi_PhoneAlreadyHere: There is already a phone there
IGUI_PhunTaxi_NotYourPhone: That is not your phone to take down
IGUI_PhunTaxi_PhoneIsKept: An admin is keeping that phone
IGUI_PhunTaxi_PhoneTakenDown: You take the phone down and pack it back into its kit
IGUI_PhunTaxi_ZonePhoneChance_tooltip: PhunTaxi: percent chance, 0 to 100, a pay phone the map puts down in this zone becomes a live one. Each phone's roll is fixed for the world, so a change reaches every phone nobody has reached yet. Leave unset for the sandbox Pay Phone Chance. At 0, no map phone goes live here
IGUI_PhunTaxi_ZonePhoneDistance_tooltip: PhunTaxi: no pay phone in this zone becomes live within this many squares of another live phone, so lower packs them closer. Leave unset for the sandbox Pay Phone Spacing. 0 for no spacing
IGUI_PhunTaxi_Options_RingVolume_tooltip: How loud an undiscovered pay phone rings, for you only. 100 is as shipped, 0 mutes it. Whether phones ring at all is the server's choice
IGUI_PhunTaxi_Options_DriveOffVolume_too: How loud the taxi pulling away is after a ride, for you only. 100 is as shipped, 0 mutes it
